input.quote: All payments provided for in this Agreement are exclusive of, (and Licensee shall pay) all taxes, customs, duties, insurance, shipping, and other charges.
input.rationale: There is no insurance covenant anywhere; the only reference to insurance is a cost we bear. Licensor hosts the Platform and the Hardware and handles our trading and client data, so the absence of E&O and cyber cover is our walk-away. Redline inserts a short insurance paragraph (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M, certificates on request) in General Provisions.

input.quote: The Licensee shall calculate the license fee payable to the Licensor for each month based on the Monthly Notional Volume bands for that pay period and shall pay the Licensor accordingly.
input.rationale: Fees are purely usage-based against volume bands, with no minimum volume, take-or-pay, shortfall or true-up obligation; the only fixed amounts are the $35,000 initial payment and $2,500/month support fee, which are not minimum purchase commitments. The floor in Article V(III)(b) is measured by actual recorded trades, so it is a reconciliation mechanic rather than a minimum. No redline required.

input.quote: Licensee shall, within five (5) days, ship to Licensor all Licensed Technology, API's Documentation with respect to the Licensed Technology and other Confidential Information in Licensee's possession or control, and an officer of Licensee shall certify in writing that Licensee as complied with the provisions of this Section.
input.rationale: Article XXI is one-directional: our rights terminate immediately and we must return everything within five days, with no transition assistance, no export of our trading/client data and no deletion certification from Licensor. That is the playbook walk-away for a hosted platform. Redline inserts up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, data return within 30 days in machine-readable form, and certified deletion, plus a regulatory record-retention carve-out.
